content.text: Hi! I'm Lingling. What's your name?
content.translation: 嗨！我是玲玲。你叫什么名字？

content.text: Hello! My name is Amy.
content.translation: 你好！我叫 Amy。

content.text: I'm Sam.
content.translation: 我是 Sam。

content.text: I'm Daming.
content.translation: 我是大明。

content.text: I'm Bobo.
content.translation: 我是 Bobo。

content.text: Goodbye, Bobo. Have a nice day!
content.translation: 再见，Bobo。祝你今天愉快！

content.text: Goodbye, Lingling!
content.translation: 再见，玲玲！

content.text: Good morning! I'm Ms Smart.
content.translation: 早上好！我是 Smart 老师。

content.text: Good morning, Ms Smart.
content.translation: 早上好，Smart 老师。

content.text: Hi, new friends! Do they have a good day?
content.translation: 嗨，新朋友们！他们今天过得愉快吗？

content.text: Hi, everyone! I'm Sam. I'm nine.
content.translation: 嗨，大家好！我是 Sam。我九岁。

content.text: She's Amy. She's nine, too. We're from the UK. We're twins!
content.translation: 她是 Amy。她也是九岁。我们来自英国。我们是双胞胎！

content.text: I'm Daming. He's Lingling.
content.translation: 我是大明。他是玲玲。

content.text: Hi, Sam. Hi, Amy. I'm Lingling. He's Daming. Come and play!
content.translation: 嗨，Sam。嗨，Amy。我是玲玲。他是大明。一起来玩吧！

content.text: Hi, I'm Mia.
content.translation: 嗨，我是 Mia。

content.text: He's David.
content.translation: 他是 David。

content.text: Hi, I'm Ben.
content.translation: 嗨，我是 Ben。

content.text: I'm nine, too. Let's play together!
content.translation: 我也九岁。让我们一起玩吧！

content.text: OK! Great!
content.translation: 好！太棒了！

content.text: Oh, no! My kite is in the tree.
content.translation: 噢，不！我的风筝在树上。

content.text: Let's help!
content.translation: 让我们来帮忙！

content.text: Here you are.
content.translation: 给你。

content.text: Thank you.
content.translation: 谢谢。

content.text: What a nice school! Look, Mum. It's my schoolbag.
content.translation: 好漂亮的学校！看，妈妈。这是我的书包。

content.text: What's in it?
content.translation: 里面有什么？

content.text: A book, a pen, a pencil, a ruler, an eraser and a pencil case.
content.translation: 一本书、一支钢笔、一支铅笔、一把尺子、一块橡皮和一个铅笔盒。

content.text: Take care of your school things.
content.translation: 要保管好你的学习用品。

content.text: Bye, kids.
content.translation: 再见，孩子们。

content.text: Bye, Ms Olivia.
content.translation: 再见，Olivia 老师。

content.text: What's this? Oh, it's a pen. What's this? It's a ruler. What's that? It's an eraser.
content.translation: 这是什么？噢，是一支钢笔。这是什么？是一把尺子。那是什么？是一块橡皮。

content.text: Whose pen is this? Is this your pen, Yoyo?
content.translation: 这是谁的钢笔？这是你的钢笔吗，Yoyo？

content.text: Yes, it is. Thank you.
content.translation: 是的，是我的。谢谢。

content.text: Is this your ruler, Lulu?
content.translation: 这是你的尺子吗，Lulu？

content.text: No, it isn't.
content.translation: 不，不是我的。

content.text: It's my ruler.
content.translation: 这是我的尺子。

content.text: It's my eraser.
content.translation: 这是我的橡皮。

content.text: Take care of your school things.
content.translation: 保管好你们的学习用品。

content.text: What do you want?
content.translation: 你想要什么？

content.text: I want a balloon!
content.translation: 我想要一个气球！

content.text: What colour is it? Can you guess?
content.translation: 是什么颜色的？你能猜吗？

content.text: It's blue!
content.translation: 是蓝色的！

content.text: Yes! Here you are.
content.translation: 好！给你。

content.text: I want a balloon, too.
content.translation: 我也想要一个气球。

content.text: What colour is it?
content.translation: 是什么颜色的？

content.text: It's red!
content.translation: 是红色的！

content.text: Bobo! Come back!
content.translation: Bobo！回来！

Unit 3 It's a colourful world!.unit: Unit 3 It's a colourful world! (Speed up)

content.text: What's this?
content.translation: 这是什么？

content.text: It's a pencil box. It's red.
content.translation: 是一个铅笔盒。是红色的。

content.text: What's this? What colour is it?
content.translation: 这是什么？是什么颜色？

content.text: It's an umbrella. It's pink.
content.translation: 是一把伞。是粉色的。

content.text: What's this? What colour is it?
content.translation: 这是什么？是什么颜色？

content.text: It's a school bag. It's green.
content.translation: 是一个书包。是绿色的。

content.text: What's that? What colour is it?
content.translation: 那是什么？是什么颜色？

content.text: It's a ruler. It's yellow.
content.translation: 是一把尺子。是黄色的。

content.text: The rainbow is colourful.
content.translation: 彩虹是五彩缤纷的。

content.text: Wow! What is it?
content.translation: 哇！这是什么？

content.text: This is a Chinese knot. It's beautiful.
content.translation: 这是一个中国结。它很漂亮。

content.text: How many ropes?
content.translation: 有多少根绳子？

content.text: Guess!
content.translation: 猜猜看！

content.text: Six? Twelve? Haha, no.
content.translation: 六根？十二根？哈哈，不对。

content.text: Look! Only one rope! That's amazing!
content.translation: 看！只有一根绳子！太神奇了！

content.text: How do you make it?
content.translation: 你怎么编的？

content.text: Let me show you.
content.translation: 我教你给你看。

content.text: OK. That's great!
content.translation: 好的。太棒了！

content.text: One! Two! Three! Four! Five! Six! Seven! Eight! Nine! Ten! Eleven! Twelve! My twelve eggs!
content.translation: 一！二！三！四！五！六！七！八！九！十！十一！十二！我的十二个蛋！

content.text: Er, I'm hungry. So she goes out for food.
content.translation: 呃，我饿了。于是她出去找食物。

content.text: One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten, eleven. Oh, no!
content.translation: 一，二，三，四，五，六，七，八，九，十，十一。噢，不！

content.text: I'm Jiajia. This is my sister. This is my dad. This is my mum. That's my grandma and that's my grandpa.
content.translation: 我是 Jiajia。这是我的妹妹/姐姐。这是我的爸爸。这是我的妈妈。那是我的奶奶/姥姥，那是我的爷爷/姥爷。

content.text: Look at the cap!
content.translation: 看那顶帽子！

content.text: Oh, no! The cap!
content.translation: 噢，不！帽子！

content.text: Come back, Lucky!
content.translation: 回来，Lucky！

content.text: Don't worry! We can help!
content.translation: 别担心！我们能帮忙！

content.text: Great!
content.translation: 太好了！

content.text: Come on, Daddy! Come on, Mummy! Come on, Brother! Let's take a photo together.
content.translation: 加油，爸爸！加油，妈妈！加油，哥哥！让我们一起拍张照片。

content.text: Oh, where's the dog? It's in the orange box! Come here, dear little dog. Let's take a photo together.
content.translation: 噢，狗在哪里？它在橙色盒子里！过来，亲爱的小狗。让我们一起拍张照片。

content.text: Dad, where's Susu?
content.translation: 爸爸，Susu 在哪儿？

content.text: She's in the living room. On the chair, I think.
content.translation: 她在客厅。我想在椅子上。

content.text: Susu is not here.
content.translation: Susu 不在这里。

content.text: Mum, where's Susu?
content.translation: 妈妈，Susu 在哪儿？

content.text: Look in the bedroom. She's under the bed.
content.translation: 在卧室里看看。她在床下。

content.text: Susu's toy is here. But where is she?
content.translation: Susu 的玩具在这里。但她在哪儿呢？

content.text: Susu?
content.translation: Susu？

content.text: Miaow...
Oh! Susu is in the box with four little babies!
content.translation: 噢！Susu 在盒子里，跟四只小宝宝在一起！

content.text: Dad's in the kitchen. Cooking is fun.
content.translation: 爸爸在厨房。做饭很有趣。

content.text: Mum's in the living room. She loves the sun.
content.translation: 妈妈在客厅。她喜欢阳光。

content.text: Brother's in the bedroom. He likes to run.
content.translation: 哥哥在卧室。他喜欢跑来跑去。

content.text: This is our home. Lucky, lucky us!
content.translation: 这是我们的家。我们真幸福！

content.text: Let's go to the zoo.
content.translation: 我们去动物园吧。

content.text: Look! What are they?
content.translation: 看！它们是什么？

content.text: They are pandas.
content.translation: 它们是熊猫。

content.text: They are cute. Can they move?
content.translation: 它们真可爱。它们会动吗？

content.text: Yes, they can.
content.translation: 是的，它们会。

content.text: The giraffes are tall. The monkeys are brown. They are strong.
content.translation: 长颈鹿很高。猴子是棕色的。它们很强壮。

content.text: Look at the elephant! It's big. Look at the tiger! It's strong.
content.translation: 看那只大象！它很大。看那只老虎！它很强壮。

content.text: Touch your head. Touch your face. Touch your nose.
content.translation: 摸摸你的头。摸摸你的脸。摸摸你的鼻子。

content.text: My head, my face, my nose.
content.translation: 我的头，我的脸，我的鼻子。

content.text: Touch your ears. Touch your mouth. Touch your eyes.
content.translation: 摸摸你的耳朵。摸摸你的嘴巴。摸摸你的眼睛。

content.text: My ears, my mouth, my eyes.
content.translation: 我的耳朵，我的嘴巴，我的眼睛。

content.text: This is my arm. This is my hand. This is my leg. This is my foot.
content.translation: 这是我的胳膊。这是我的手。这是我的腿。这是我的脚。

content.text: Wave your arms. Clap your hands. Stamp your foot.
content.translation: 挥挥你的胳膊。拍拍你的手。跺跺你的脚。

content.text: What's your favourite food?
content.translation: 你最喜欢什么食物？

content.text: I like noodles. They're yummy.
content.translation: 我喜欢面条。它们很好吃。

content.text: What about you, Amy?
content.translation: 你呢，Amy？

content.text: I like rice. It's yummy, too.
content.translation: 我喜欢米饭。它也很好吃。

content.text: I like meat. I don't like fish.
content.translation: 我喜欢肉。我不喜欢鱼。

content.text: I like vegetables. I don't like candy.
content.translation: 我喜欢蔬菜。我不喜欢糖果。

content.text: What's your hobby?
content.translation: 你的爱好是什么？

content.text: I like reading. I like reading books.
content.translation: 我喜欢阅读。我喜欢读书。

content.text: I like singing. I like singing songs.
content.translation: 我喜欢唱歌。我喜欢唱歌。

content.text: I like drawing. I like drawing pictures.
content.translation: 我喜欢画画。我喜欢画图画。

content.text: I like dancing. I like dancing to music.
content.translation: 我喜欢跳舞。我喜欢跟着音乐跳舞。

content.text: I like playing. I like playing games.
content.translation: 我喜欢玩。我喜欢玩游戏。

content.text: What time is it?
content.translation: 几点了？

content.text: It's seven o'clock. It's time to get up.
content.translation: 七点了。该起床了。

content.text: It's eight o'clock. It's time for school.
content.translation: 八点了。该上学了。

Unit 5 What time is it?.unit: Unit 5 What time is it? (Speed up)

content.text: It's twelve o'clock. It's time for lunch.
content.translation: 十二点了。该吃午饭了。

content.text: It's nine o'clock. It's time for bed.
content.translation: 九点了。该睡觉了。

content.text: What day is it today?
content.translation: 今天星期几？

content.text: It's Monday. I go to school on Mondays.
content.translation: 今天星期一。我星期一去上学。

content.text: It's Saturday. I play football on Saturdays.
content.translation: 今天星期六。我星期六踢足球。

content.text: I go to the park on Sundays.
content.translation: 我星期天去公园。

content.text: I read books on Fridays.
content.translation: 我星期五读书。

content.text: Can you jump high, Daming?
content.translation: 大明，你能跳得高吗？

content.text: Yes, I can.
content.translation: 是的，我能。

content.text: Can you run fast, Sam?
content.translation: 萨姆，你能跑得快吗？

content.text: Yes, I can.
content.translation: 是的，我能。

content.text: Can you play ping-pong, Lingling?
content.translation: 玲玲，你会打乒乓球吗？

content.text: Yes, I can.
content.translation: 是的，我会。

content.text: Can you swim, Daming?
content.translation: 大明，你会游泳吗？

content.text: No, I can't. But I can learn.
content.translation: 不，我不会。但是我可以学。

content.text: I can swim now!
content.translation: 我现在会游泳啦！

content.text: Wow! You can swim fast!
content.translation: 哇！你游得真快！

content.text: This is Terry Fox. He lost one leg because of cancer.
content.translation: 这是特里·福克斯。他因为癌症失去了一条腿。

content.text: He ran across Canada to get money for the people with cancer.
content.translation: 他跑遍加拿大为癌症患者筹钱。

content.text: It's OK to fail. Don't give up!
content.translation: 失败没关系。不要放弃！

content.text: Never stop! Work hard and try your best!
content.translation: 永不停止！努力工作，尽你最大的努力！

content.text: Dad, may I play outside?
content.translation: 爸爸，我可以出去玩吗？

content.text: Yes. But can you tidy your room first?
content.translation: 可以。但是你能先整理你的房间吗？

content.text: Bobby, can you help me clean the floor?
content.translation: 波比，你能帮我擦地板吗？

content.text: OK. That's easy.
content.translation: 好的。那很容易。

content.text: Go, Bobby! Good job!
content.translation: 加油，波比！干得好！

content.text: Sam, are you still busy?
content.translation: 萨姆，你还在忙吗？

content.text: Yes, Dad. I need to clean the floor, the desk and the wall.
content.translation: 是的，爸爸。我需要擦地板、书桌和墙。

content.text: Bobby, stop! Look! It's so dirty now!
content.translation: 波比，停下！看！现在它好脏啊！

content.text: Phew! So much work! Let's work together.
content.translation: 唷！好多活儿啊！让我们一起干吧。

content.text: Wash the dishes. Feed the dog. Make the beds. Wash the clothes.
content.translation: 洗碗。喂狗。铺床。洗衣服。

content.text: Sweep the floor. Take out the rubbish.
content.translation: 扫地。倒垃圾。

content.text: Everyone, well done! Chores can be fun!
content.translation: 大家干得好！家务也可以很有趣！

Unit 3 What's the weather like?.unit: Unit 3 What's the weather like? (Start up)

content.text: What's the weather like?
content.translation: 天气怎么样？

content.text: It's sunny and warm. We can go out to play.
content.translation: 晴朗又暖和。我们可以出去玩。

content.text: Oh, it's cool!
content.translation: 哦，好凉快！

content.text: It's windy and cloudy. Let's go home!
content.translation: 又刮风又阴天。我们回家吧！

content.text: Oh! It's rainy now. Let's run!
content.translation: 哦！现在下雨了。我们快跑！

content.text: Look! I've got a good idea.
content.translation: 看！我有个好主意。

content.text: Our umbrellas are great!
content.translation: 我们的雨伞太棒了！

content.text: The sun comes up... It's sunny.
content.translation: 太阳升起来了……天晴了。

content.text: The clouds go by... It's cloudy.
content.translation: 云飘过去了……天阴了。

content.text: The wind blows around... It's windy.
content.translation: 风吹来吹去……起风了。

content.text: The rain comes down... It's rainy.
content.translation: 雨落下来了……下雨了。

content.text: The snow dances around... It's snowy.
content.translation: 雪飞舞着……下雪了。

content.text: In any weather, we have fun. Hot, cold, cool or warm. Enjoy them all!
content.translation: 无论什么天气，我们都开心。热、冷、凉、暖，全都享受！

content.text: I'm Li Han. This is my apple tree.
content.translation: 我是李涵。这是我的苹果树。

content.text: I'm ten now. The tree is ten, too. Spring is here! The birds are back.
content.translation: 我现在十岁了。这棵树也十岁了。春天来了！鸟儿回来了。

content.text: It's summer. The apple tree is like a sun umbrella. I like reading under it.
content.translation: 夏天到了。苹果树像一把太阳伞。我喜欢在树下读书。

content.text: It's autumn. I like autumn best! There are many red apples on the tree!
content.translation: 秋天到了。我最喜欢秋天！树上有很多红苹果！

content.text: Can I share the apples with my friends? Sure!
content.translation: 我能和朋友们分享这些苹果吗？当然！

content.text: It's winter. My apple tree has warm, new clothes.
content.translation: 冬天到了。我的苹果树穿上了暖和的新衣服。

content.text: A snowstorm comes. Oh, no! My apple tree! I don't like winter!
content.translation: 暴风雪来了。哦，不！我的苹果树！我不喜欢冬天！

content.text: Don't worry. Let's wait for spring.
content.translation: 别担心。让我们等待春天。

content.text: It's spring again. My apple tree grows again. Hooray!
content.translation: 春天又来了。我的苹果树又生长了。万岁！

content.text: Let's go for a picnic in the park.
content.translation: 我们去公园野餐吧。

content.text: Hooray!
content.translation: 万岁！

content.text: How do we get there?
content.translation: 我们怎么到那里？

content.text: Let's go by car! It's fast!
content.translation: 我们开车去吧！很快！

content.text: No, let's go in a "green" way!
content.translation: 不，让我们用“绿色”的方式去！

content.text: A green way?
content.translation: 绿色的方式？

content.text: Yes. Go and get ready. Let's meet in five minutes.
content.translation: 是的。去准备吧。我们五分钟后见。

content.text: We're green now! Let's go!
content.translation: 我们现在是绿色的了！出发！

content.text: Ha ha! Not that kind of green!
content.translation: 哈哈！不是那种绿色！

content.text: This kind of green!
content.translation: 是这种绿色！

content.text: We can go by bus, going up and down.
content.translation: 我们可以坐公交车，上上下下。

content.text: We can go by car, to get around.
content.translation: 我们可以坐汽车，四处逛逛。

content.text: We can go by train, from city to town.
content.translation: 我们可以坐火车，从城市到小镇。

content.text: We can go by ship, across the sea.
content.translation: 我们可以坐大船，横跨大海。

content.text: We can go by plane, high up in the sky.
content.translation: 我们可以坐飞机，高高飞在天上。

content.text: We can go to different places, near and far.
content.translation: 我们可以去不同的地方，或近或远。

content.text: My cat Susu goes out every morning! Where does she go?
content.translation: 我的猫苏苏每天早上都出去！她去哪儿？

content.text: Where does she go? I don't know! Let's find out tomorrow.
content.translation: 她去哪儿？我不知道！我们明天去查个明白。

content.text: Susu goes straight on to the museum. She turns left there.
content.translation: 苏苏直着走到博物馆。她在那里左转。

content.text: At the hospital, she turns right.
content.translation: 在医院那里，她右转。

content.text: Then Susu stops. Let's go there!
content.translation: 然后苏苏停下了。我们去那儿吧！

content.text: Go straight on to the museum. Then turn left.
content.translation: 直着走到博物馆。然后左转。

content.text: Turn right at the hospital.
content.translation: 在医院那里右转。

content.text: The wheels on the bus go round and round.
content.translation: 公交车的轮子转啊转。

content.text: Turn left and go straight on. Ding! Ding! Ding! Here's the library.
content.translation: 左转再直走。叮！叮！叮！这里是图书馆。

content.text: The wheels on the bus go round and round.
content.translation: 公交车的轮子转啊转。

content.text: Turn right and go straight on. Ding! Ding! Ding! Here's the sports centre.
content.translation: 右转再直走。叮！叮！叮！这里是体育中心。

content.text: This is Ms Wang. She's a nice teacher.
content.translation: 这是王老师。她是一位好老师。

content.text: This is Maomao. She's a clever pupil.
content.translation: 这是毛毛。她是一个聪明的学生。

content.text: This is Tom. He's a clever pupil, too.
content.translation: 这是汤姆。他也是一个聪明的学生。

content.text: This is Xiaoyong. He's very shy.
content.translation: 这是小勇。他很害羞。

content.text: Parrot is a naughty bird. But it's very clever!
content.translation: 鹦鹉是一只调皮的鸟。但它非常聪明！

content.text: Look at this picture. This is my friend.
content.translation: 看这张照片。这是我朋友。

content.text: She's cute. She's very active in class.
content.translation: 她很可爱。她在课堂上非常活跃。

content.text: What about you? Are you active?
content.translation: 你呢？你活跃吗？

content.text: Yes, I am! I like English class.
content.translation: 是的，我很活跃！我喜欢英语课。

Module 2 It's very old.unit: Unit 1 London is a big city

content.text: London is a big city. It's very famous.
content.translation: 伦敦是一座大城市。它非常有名。

content.text: Look at Big Ben! It's very old.
content.translation: 看大本钟！它非常古老。

content.text: This is Buckingham Palace. The Queen lives here.
content.translation: 这是白金汉宫。女王住在这里。

content.text: Hyde Park is beautiful. There are lots of trees.
content.translation: 海德公园很美。有很多树。

content.text: This is Tower Bridge. It's very famous.
content.translation: 这是塔桥。它非常有名。

content.text: It's 127 years old. It's very old!
content.translation: 它有127年了。它非常古老！

content.text: The Great Wall is very old too. It's thousands of years old.
content.translation: 长城也很古老。它有几千年的历史了。

content.text: China has many old buildings. They're amazing!
content.translation: 中国有很多古老的建筑。它们真令人惊叹！

Module 3 What are they doing?.unit: Unit 1 Sam is riding a bike

content.text: Look! Sam is riding a bike.
content.translation: 看！萨姆正在骑自行车。

content.text: What is Lingling doing?
content.translation: 玲玲正在做什么？

content.text: She's playing with her dog.
content.translation: 她正在和她的狗玩耍。

content.text: I'm riding my bike in the park. It's fun!
content.translation: 我正在公园里骑自行车。真有趣！

content.text: Look! They're having a picnic.
content.translation: 看！他们正在野餐。

content.text: What are they eating?
content.translation: 他们正在吃什么？

content.text: They're eating sandwiches and drinking juice.
content.translation: 他们正在吃三明治和喝果汁。

content.text: The weather is nice. Let's join them!
content.translation: 天气真好。我们去加入他们吧！

Module 4 Do you want some rice?.unit: Unit 1 Do you want some rice?

content.text: Daming, do you want some rice?
content.translation: 大明，你想吃一些米饭吗？

content.text: Yes, please. I want a lot of rice.
content.translation: 好的，谢谢。我想要很多米饭。

content.text: What about some noodles?
content.translation: 吃一些面条怎么样？

content.text: No, thank you. I only want rice today.
content.translation: 不，谢谢。今天我只想吃米饭。

content.text: What do you want, Lingling?
content.translation: 你想吃什么，玲玲？

content.text: I like chicken. I want some chicken, please.
content.translation: 我喜欢鸡肉。我想要一些鸡肉。

content.text: Do you want some vegetables?
content.translation: 你想要一些蔬菜吗？

content.text: Yes, I like carrots and potatoes.
content.translation: 是的，我喜欢胡萝卜和土豆。

content.text: Can you run fast, Sam?
content.translation: 萨姆，你能跑得快吗？

content.text: Yes, I can. I'm very fast.
content.translation: 是的，我能。我跑得很快。

content.text: What about you, Amy?
content.translation: 你呢，Amy？

content.text: No, I can't run fast. But I can swim well.
content.translation: 不，我跑不快。但我游泳很好。

content.text: Can you jump high?
content.translation: 你能跳得高吗？

content.text: Yes, I can. I can jump very high.
content.translation: 是的，我能。我能跳得很高。

content.text: Can you jump far?
content.translation: 你能跳得远吗？

content.text: No, I can't. But I'm good at running.
content.translation: 不，我不能。但我擅长跑步。

Module 6 Can I have some sweets?.unit: Unit 1 Can I have some sweets?

content.text: Mum, can I have some sweets?
content.translation: 妈妈，我能吃一些糖果吗？

content.text: No, you can't. Sweets are not healthy.
content.translation: 不，你不能。糖果不健康。

content.text: Can I have some fruit then?
content.translation: 那我能吃一些水果吗？

content.text: Yes, of course. Fruit is very good for you.
content.translation: 当然可以。水果对你很有好处。

Module 6 Can I have some sweets?.unit: Unit 2 I don't want any sweets

content.text: Do you want some sweets, Lingling?
content.translation: 你想要一些糖果吗，玲玲？

content.text: No, thank you. I don't want any sweets.
content.translation: 不，谢谢。我不想要任何糖果。

content.text: What do you want?
content.translation: 你想要什么？

content.text: I want some water, please.
content.translation: 请给我一些水。

Module 7 There is a horse in this photo.unit: Unit 1 There is a horse in this photo

content.text: Look at this photo. There is a horse.
content.translation: 看这张照片。有一匹马。

content.text: There are many animals in the photo.
content.translation: 照片里有很多动物。

content.text: There is a cow and some sheep too.
content.translation: 还有一头奶牛和一些绵羊。

content.text: The farm is beautiful. I like animals.
content.translation: 农场很美。我喜欢动物。

Module 7 There is a horse in this photo.unit: Unit 2 There are lots of horses

content.text: There are lots of horses on the farm.
content.translation: 农场上有许多马。

content.text: Are there any cows?
content.translation: 有奶牛吗？

content.text: Yes, there are. There are also some pigs.
content.translation: 是的，有。还有一些猪。

content.text: I can count them. One, two, three...!
content.translation: 我可以数它们。一、二、三……！

Module 8 We're going to visit Hainan.unit: Unit 1 We're going to visit Hainan

content.text: Where are you going this summer?
content.translation: 今年夏天你打算去哪里？

content.text: We're going to visit Hainan. It's very warm there.
content.translation: 我们打算去海南。那里很暖和。

content.text: Are you going by plane?
content.translation: 你们打算坐飞机去吗？

content.text: Yes, we're flying to Hainan.
content.translation: 是的，我们要飞往海南。

Module 8 We're going to visit Hainan.unit: Unit 2 I'm going to go to the beach

content.text: What are you going to do in Hainan?
content.translation: 你打算在海南做什么？

content.text: I'm going to swim in the sea.
content.translation: 我打算在海里游泳。

content.text: I'm going to play on the beach.
content.translation: 我打算在海滩上玩。

content.text: We're going to have a great time!
content.translation: 我们一定会玩得很开心！

Module 9 Are you going to run on sports.unit: Unit 1 Are you going to run on sports day?

content.text: Sports Day is coming. Are you going to run?
content.translation: 运动会快到了。你打算跑步吗？

content.text: Yes, I'm going to run in the 100 metres.
content.translation: 是的，我打算参加100米跑。

content.text: What about you, Amy?
content.translation: 你呢，Amy？

content.text: I'm going to jump. I can jump very high.
content.translation: 我打算跳远。我能跳得很高。

Module 9 Are you going to run on sports.unit: Unit 2 Are you going to win?

content.text: Are you going to win, Sam?
content.translation: 你打算赢吗，萨姆？

content.text: I'm going to try my best!
content.translation: 我会尽力的！

content.text: Good luck! I believe in you.
content.translation: 祝你好运！我相信你。

content.text: Thank you! See you at the sports ground!
content.translation: 谢谢！运动场上见！

Module 10 We have a big family dinner.unit: Unit 1 We have a big family dinner

content.text: Chinese New Year is coming. We're going to have a big dinner.
content.translation: 春节快到了。我们打算吃一顿大餐。

content.text: What are you going to eat?
content.translation: 你们打算吃什么？

content.text: We're going to eat dumplings, fish, and lots of nice food.
content.translation: 我们打算吃饺子、鱼和很多好吃的。

content.text: That sounds delicious! I love dumplings.
content.translation: 听起来太好吃了！我爱吃饺子。

Module 10 We have a big family dinner.unit: Unit 2 We are having a party

content.text: We're having a party. Do you want to come?
content.translation: 我们要办派对。你想来吗？

content.text: Yes, I'd love to. What time?
content.translation: 是的，我很想来。几点？

content.text: It's at 6 o'clock in the evening.
content.translation: 晚上六点。

content.text: Great! See you then!
content.translation: 太棒了！到时候见！

Module 1 Did you come back yesterday?.unit: Unit 1 Did you come back yesterday?

content.text: Daming, did you come back yesterday?
content.translation: 大明，你昨天回来的吗？

content.text: Yes, I came back yesterday evening.
content.translation: 是的，我昨天晚上回来的。

content.text: What did you do yesterday?
content.translation: 你昨天做了什么？

content.text: I played football with my friends. It was fun!
content.translation: 我和朋友们踢足球了。真有趣！

content.text: Sam and Amy went to the park yesterday.
content.translation: 萨姆和艾米昨天去了公园。

content.text: What did they do there?
content.translation: 他们在那里做了什么？

content.text: They met John in the park. They bought ice creams.
content.translation: 他们在公园遇到了约翰。他们买了冰淇淋。

content.text: Did they have a nice time?
content.translation: 他们玩得开心吗？

content.text: Yes, they did! But Lingling dropped her ice cream.
content.translation: 是的，很开心！但是玲玲把冰淇淋掉了。

content.text: Daming, what did you buy yesterday?
content.translation: 大明，你昨天买了什么？

content.text: I bought a new pen. It's blue.
content.translation: 我买了一支新钢笔。是蓝色的。

content.text: Did you buy any books?
content.translation: 你买书了吗？

content.text: Yes, I bought two English books.
content.translation: 是的，我买了两本英语书。

Module 2 What did you buy?.unit: Unit 2 How much cheese did you buy?

content.text: Can I help you?
content.translation: 请问需要什么？

content.text: How much cheese did you buy?
content.translation: 你买了多少奶酪？

content.text: I bought half a kilo of cheese.
content.translation: 我买了半公斤奶酪。

content.text: And how much milk?
content.translation: 还有多少牛奶？

content.text: I bought two bottles of milk.
content.translation: 我买了两瓶牛奶。

content.text: Where did you go last weekend?
content.translation: 你上周末去哪里了？

content.text: I went to the mountains with my family.
content.translation: 我和家人去爬山了。

content.text: That sounds great! Did you take any photos?
content.translation: 听起来太棒了！你拍照了吗？

content.text: Yes, I took lots of photos. The views were beautiful.
content.translation: 是的，我拍了很多照片。风景很美。

Module 3 Where did you go?.unit: Unit 2 Daming took a photo of his father

content.text: What's this photo about, Daming?
content.translation: 这张照片是关于什么的，大明？

content.text: Daming took a photo of his father.
content.translation: 大明给他爸爸拍了照片。

content.text: Where was your father, Daming?
content.translation: 你爸爸在哪里？

content.text: He was in the park. He was reading a book.
content.translation: 他在公园里。他在读书。

Module 4 Mum bought a new T-shirt for me.unit: Unit 1 Mum bought a new T-shirt for me

content.text: Mum bought a new T-shirt for me. It's red.
content.translation: 妈妈给我买了一件新T恤。是红色的。

content.text: It's very nice! How much was it?
content.translation: 真漂亮！多少钱？

content.text: It was fifty yuan. It was a good price.
content.translation: 五十元。价格很划算。

content.text: My mum bought a new dress for me. It's blue.
content.translation: 我妈妈给我买了一条新裙子。是蓝色的。

Module 4 Mum bought a new T-shirt for me.unit: Unit 2 What's the matter with Daming?

content.text: What's the matter with Daming?
content.translation: 大明怎么了？

content.text: He lost his new T-shirt. He's very sad.
content.translation: 他把新T恤弄丢了。他很伤心。

content.text: Don't worry. We'll help you find it.
content.translation: 别担心。我们会帮你找到的。

content.text: Thank you, friends!
content.translation: 谢谢你们，朋友们！

Module 5 There are only nineteen crayons.unit: Unit 1 There are only nineteen crayons

content.text: How many crayons do you have?
content.translation: 你有多少蜡笔？

content.text: There are only nineteen crayons. I need twenty.
content.translation: 只有十九支蜡笔。我需要二十支。

content.text: Here are some more crayons for you.
content.translation: 这里有一些蜡笔给你。

content.text: Thank you! Now I have twenty-one crayons.
content.translation: 谢谢！现在我有二十一支蜡笔了。

content.text: How many books do you have?
content.translation: 你有多少本书？

content.text: There are forty books on my shelf.
content.translation: 我的书架上有四十本书。

content.text: That's a lot of books! I have thirty.
content.translation: 好多书啊！我有三十本。

content.text: Reading is great! Let's read together.
content.translation: 阅读真棒！我们一起读书吧。

Module 6 You can play football well.unit: Unit 1 You can play football well

content.text: Sam, you can play football well!
content.translation: 萨姆，你足球踢得很好！

content.text: Thank you, coach. I practice every day.
content.translation: 谢谢，教练。我每天都在练习。

content.text: Daming, you can run very fast.
content.translation: 大明，你能跑得很快。

content.text: Yes! I'm the fastest in my class.
content.translation: 是的！我是班里跑得最快的。

content.text: Who ran in the race yesterday?
content.translation: 昨天谁参加了跑步比赛？

content.text: Daming ran very fast. He came first!
content.translation: 大明跑得非常快。他得了第一名！

content.text: That's wonderful! Did Sam run fast too?
content.translation: 太棒了！萨姆也跑得快吗？

content.text: Yes, he did. He came second.
content.translation: 是的，他跑得很快。他得了第二名。

content.text: This is my friend. He can't see.
content.translation: 这是我朋友。他看不见。

content.text: What can he do?
content.translation: 他会做什么？

content.text: He can listen very well. He can read books with his hands.
content.translation: 他听力很好。他能用双手读书。

content.text: That's amazing! We should help him.
content.translation: 太神奇了！我们应该帮助他。

Module 7 He can't see.unit: Unit 2 This little girl can't walk

content.text: Who is she? What happened to her?
content.translation: 她是谁？她怎么了？

content.text: This little girl can't walk. But she can swim very well.
content.translation: 这个小女孩不能走路。但她游泳游得很好。

content.text: That's wonderful! Everyone can do something well.
content.translation: 太棒了！每个人都能做好一些事情。

content.text: Yes! We should all try our best.
content.translation: 是的！我们都应该尽力。

content.text: Dogs are very useful. They can help people.
content.translation: 狗非常有用。它们能帮助人们。

content.text: My grandma has a dog. It can guard the house.
content.translation: 我奶奶有一条狗。它能看家。

content.text: Some dogs can guide blind people. They're wonderful.
content.translation: 有些狗能引导盲人。它们真了不起。

content.text: Yes. Dogs are our good friends.
content.translation: 是的。狗是我们人类的好朋友。

Module 8 Dogs are very useful.unit: Unit 2 A dog is a useful animal

content.text: A dog is a useful animal. It can do many things.
content.translation: 狗是一种有用的动物。它能做很多事情。

content.text: Some dogs can help the police. They can find bad people.
content.translation: 有些狗能帮助警察。它们能找到坏人。

content.text: Dogs are amazing. I love dogs.
content.translation: 狗真神奇。我喜欢狗。

content.text: Me too! They're the best friends of humans.
content.translation: 我也是！它们是人类最好的朋友。

content.text: Are you feeling bored, Daming?
content.translation: 你觉得无聊吗，大明？

content.text: Yes, I am. There's nothing to do.
content.translation: 是的，我很无聊。没什么事情可做。

content.text: Why don't you read a book?
content.translation: 你为什么不读一本书呢？

content.text: Good idea! Reading is fun.
content.translation: 好主意！阅读很有趣。

content.text: Are you feeling happy, Amy?
content.translation: 你感到开心吗，Amy？

content.text: Yes, I am! I passed my English test.
content.translation: 是的，我很开心！我英语考试及格了。

content.text: Congratulations! That's wonderful news.
content.translation: 恭喜你！这是好消息。

content.text: Thank you! Now I feel excited and happy.
content.translation: 谢谢！现在我觉得既兴奋又开心。

Module 10 He was in the kitchen.unit: Unit 1 He was in the kitchen

content.text: Let's play hide and seek!
content.translation: 我们玩捉迷藏吧！

content.text: OK! Where did you find Sam?
content.translation: 好的！你在哪里找到萨姆的？

content.text: I found Sam in the kitchen. He was cooking!
content.translation: 我在厨房找到萨姆的。他在做饭！

content.text: I was the winner. You found me last!
content.translation: 我是赢家。你们最后才找到我！

content.text: Don't shout, please! This is a library.
content.translation: 请不要大声喧哗！这里是图书馆。

content.text: Sorry, we forgot. We were too excited.
content.translation: 对不起，我们忘了。我们太兴奋了。

content.text: In the library, we should be quiet.
content.translation: 在图书馆里，我们应该保持安静。

content.text: Yes, we understand. We'll be quiet now.
content.translation: 好的，我们明白了。我们现在会安静的。

Module 1 She had a little lamb.unit: Unit 1 There are two beautiful cats on the chair.

content.text: Look! There are two beautiful cats on the chair.
content.translation: 看！椅子上有两只漂亮的猫。

content.text: There is only one now.
content.translation: 现在只有一只了。

content.text: Well, there were two.
content.translation: 嗯，刚刚有两只。

content.text: Look, Lingling! It's a programme about China. Come and watch!
content.translation: 看，玲玲！这是一个关于中国的节目。快来看！

content.text: I'm coming!
content.translation: 我来了！

Module 1 She had a little lamb.unit: Unit 2 Life was very different in China many years ago.

content.text: Life was very different in China many years ago.
content.translation: 许多年前，中国的生活和现在大不相同。

content.text: We lived in a small house. We didn't have enough food.
content.translation: 我们住在一个小房子里。我们没有足够的食物。

content.text: There weren't many buses. There weren't any televisions.
content.translation: 没有很多公共汽车。没有电视机。

content.text: Now we live in a big house. We have lots of food.
content.translation: 现在我们住在一座大房子里。我们有很多食物。

content.text: I watch TV every day. Yesterday I watched TV with my grandchildren.
content.translation: 我每天都看电视。昨天我和孙子孙女一起看电视了。

content.text: Thank you for talking to us.
content.translation: 谢谢你和我们谈话。

content.text: China is changing.
content.translation: 中国正在变化。

content.text: I miss China! I miss my grandma!
content.translation: 我想念中国！我想念我的奶奶！

content.text: Who are they?
content.translation: 他们是谁？

content.text: They're my grandparents.
content.translation: 他们是我的祖父母。

content.text: This is my grandma. She learned to dance.
content.translation: 这是我奶奶。她学过跳舞。

content.text: She learned to cook, too. She taught languages and wrote books.
content.translation: 她也学过做饭。她教语言并写书。

content.text: Did she learn English?
content.translation: 她学过英语吗？

content.text: Yes, she did. She learned English at school.
content.translation: 是的，她学过。她在学校学过英语。

content.text: This is my grandpa.
content.translation: 这是我爷爷。

content.text: He was a driver before. He drove a bus.
content.translation: 他以前是司机。他开公交车。

content.text: Did he learn English?
content.translation: 他学过英语吗？

content.text: No, he didn't. But now he is learning English.
content.translation: 不，他没有。但现在他正在学英语。

content.text: He learns English every day. He can say ABC now!
content.translation: 他每天学英语。他现在会说字母ABC了！

Module 3 She had eggs and sausages.unit: Unit 1 She had eggs and sausages.

content.text: Sam, what did you have for breakfast?
content.translation: 萨姆，你早餐吃了什么？

content.text: I had eggs and sausages. I drank milk.
content.translation: 我吃了鸡蛋和香肠。我喝了牛奶。

content.text: Did Amy have eggs, too?
content.translation: 艾米也吃鸡蛋了吗？

content.text: No, she didn't. She had bread and butter.
content.translation: 不，她没有。她吃了黄油面包。

content.text: What about Lingling?
content.translation: 玲玲呢？

content.text: She had noodles. She likes noodles very much.
content.translation: 她吃了面条。她非常喜欢吃面条。

content.text: Sam, what did you eat at the party?
content.translation: 萨姆，你在派对上吃了什么？

content.text: I ate four hamburgers! I'm very hungry.
content.translation: 我吃了四个汉堡包！我非常饿。

content.text: Four hamburgers? That's a lot!
content.translation: 四个汉堡包？真多！

content.text: I'm still hungry. I want some more food.
content.translation: 我还是饿。我还想吃点东西。

content.text: No more food! You ate too much.
content.translation: 不能再吃了！你吃得太多了。

Module 4 Let's make a home library.unit: Unit 1 Let's make a home library.

content.text: We have lots of books. Let's make a home library!
content.translation: 我们有很多书。我们来建一个家庭图书馆吧！

content.text: Good idea! We can put books on the shelf.
content.translation: 好主意！我们可以把书放在书架上。

content.text: Let's put all the books together.
content.translation: 让我们把所有书放在一起吧。

content.text: We can find information from books and CDs.
content.translation: 我们可以从书和光盘里找到信息。

content.text: Now we can read in our home library every day!
content.translation: 现在我们可以每天在家里读书了！

Module 4 Let's make a home library.unit: Unit 2 We can find information from books and CDs.

content.text: What do you want to know?
content.translation: 你想知道什么？

content.text: I want to know about space. I read books and watched CDs.
content.translation: 我想了解太空。我读书和看光盘了。

content.text: That's great! You can find information from books and CDs.
content.translation: 太棒了！你可以从书和光盘里找到信息。

content.text: I want to know about animals. I found information in the library.
content.translation: 我想了解动物。我在图书馆找到了信息。

content.text: Books and libraries are very useful!
content.translation: 书和图书馆非常有用！

Module 5 There's a bird in the tower.unit: Unit 1 There's a bird in the tower.

content.text: Look! There's a bird in the tower.
content.translation: 看！塔里有一只鸟。

content.text: Where is it? I can't see it.
content.translation: 在哪里？我看不见。

content.text: It's on the old wall. It's a beautiful bird.
content.translation: 它在旧墙上。它是一只漂亮的鸟。

content.text: I can see it now! It has red and blue feathers.
content.translation: 我现在能看见它了！它有红色和蓝色的羽毛。

content.text: Let's take a photo of it!
content.translation: 让我们给它拍张照吧！

Module 5 There's a bird in the tower.unit: Unit 2 I saw a mouse in the house.

content.text: I saw a mouse in the house yesterday!
content.translation: 昨天我在房子里看见一只老鼠！

content.text: A mouse? Where did you see it?
content.translation: 一只老鼠？你在哪里看见的？

content.text: I saw it under the table. It ran away very fast!
content.translation: 我在桌子底下看见的。它跑得非常快！

content.text: There are lots of mice in old houses.
content.translation: 老房子里有很多老鼠。

content.text: Let's catch it! We can put cheese in a trap.
content.translation: 让我们抓住它吧！我们可以把奶酪放在捕鼠夹里。

Module 6 The moon is beautiful tonight.unit: Unit 1 The moon is beautiful tonight.

content.text: Look at the moon tonight! It's beautiful.
content.translation: 今晚看月亮！真美。

content.text: The moon is bright tonight. I can see the stars.
content.translation: 今晚月亮很亮。我能看见星星。

content.text: I want to go to the moon one day.
content.translation: 我想有一天去月球。

content.text: Maybe you can! People went to the moon in 1969.
content.translation: 也许你可以！人们在1969年登上了月球。

content.text: They flew in a rocket. That was amazing!
content.translation: 他们乘火箭飞上去的。那真令人惊叹！

Module 6 The moon is beautiful tonight.unit: Unit 2 I took some photos of the moon.

content.text: What did you do last night?
content.translation: 你昨晚做了什么？

content.text: I took some photos of the moon.
content.translation: 我拍了一些月亮的照片。

content.text: That's wonderful! Can I see them?
content.translation: 太棒了！我可以看看吗？

content.text: Yes! Look at this photo. The moon is very big here.
content.translation: 可以！看这张照片。这里的月亮非常大。

content.text: The stars are beautiful too. Space is so amazing!
content.translation: 星星也很美。太空真神奇！

Module 7 We can save the world.unit: Unit 1 Don't put things in the bin.

content.text: Look at this picture. The world is beautiful.
content.translation: 看这张图片。世界很美丽。

content.text: But there is too much rubbish. Don't put things in the bin!
content.translation: 但有太多垃圾。不要把东西扔进垃圾桶！

content.text: We can reuse things. We can recycle paper and plastic.
content.translation: 我们可以重复使用东西。我们可以回收纸和塑料。

content.text: We can save the world if we try our best!
content.translation: 如果我们尽力，我们可以拯救世界！

content.text: Let's all do something to help our world.
content.translation: 让我们都为我们的世界做点什么吧。

content.text: The world needs love and care.
content.translation: 世界需要爱和关爱。

content.text: We should plant more trees. Trees make the air clean.
content.translation: 我们应该种更多的树。树使空气清新。

content.text: We should save water. Water is very important.
content.translation: 我们应该节约用水。水非常重要。

content.text: And we should use less plastic. The world needs us!
content.translation: 而且我们应该少用塑料。世界需要我们！

Module 8 The tiger fights the lion.unit: Unit 1 The tiger is stronger than the elephant.

content.text: Which animal is stronger, the tiger or the elephant?
content.translation: 哪种动物更强壮，老虎还是大象？

content.text: The tiger is stronger than the elephant.
content.translation: 老虎比大象更强壮。

content.text: Which is taller, the giraffe or the horse?
content.translation: 哪种更高，长颈鹿还是马？

content.text: The giraffe is taller than the horse.
content.translation: 长颈鹿比马高。

content.text: In the wild, animals are very strong.
content.translation: 在野外，动物非常强壮。

Module 8 The tiger fights the lion.unit: Unit 2 The tiger fights the lion.

content.text: Look at the picture. The tiger fights the lion!
content.translation: 看这张图。老虎和狮子在打架！

content.text: The tiger is fast and strong. The lion is also strong.
content.translation: 老虎又快又壮。狮子也很强壮。

content.text: The tiger is faster than the lion. But the lion is braver.
content.translation: 老虎比狮子快。但狮子更勇敢。

content.text: All animals are amazing. We should protect them.
content.translation: 所有动物都很神奇。我们应该保护它们。

content.text: Daming, are you feeling bored?
content.translation: 大明，你感到无聊吗？

content.text: Yes, I am. There's nothing to do.
content.translation: 是的，我无聊。没什么事可做。

content.text: Why don't you draw a picture?
content.translation: 你为什么不画一幅画呢？

content.text: Good idea! I like drawing.
content.translation: 好主意！我喜欢画画。

content.text: You can sing a song too.
content.translation: 你也可以唱首歌。

content.text: Now I'm not bored anymore. I feel happy!
content.translation: 现在我不再无聊了。我感到开心！

content.text: Are you feeling excited, Amy?
content.translation: 你感到兴奋吗，艾米？

content.text: Yes, I am! We're going on a trip tomorrow.
content.translation: 是的，我很兴奋！我们明天要去旅行。

content.text: Are you feeling nervous?
content.translation: 你感到紧张吗？

content.text: A little. But I'm more excited than nervous.
content.translation: 有一点。但我更多的是兴奋而不是紧张。

content.text: Have a great trip! Take lots of photos!
content.translation: 旅途愉快！多拍些照片！

content.text: Where are you going this weekend, Sam?
content.translation: 萨姆，这个周末你要去哪里？

content.text: I don't know.
content.translation: 我不知道。

content.text: When are you going to get up?
content.translation: 你打算什么时候起床？

content.text: I don't know.
content.translation: 我不知道。

content.text: What are you going to take?
content.translation: 你打算带什么？

content.text: I don't know! You always tell me what to do!
content.translation: 我不知道！你总是告诉我该做什么！

Module 10 What did you put in your bag?.unit: Unit 2 I'm going to the airport.

content.text: Where are you going, Amy?
content.translation: 你要去哪里，艾米？

content.text: I'm going to the airport. I'm flying to London!
content.translation: 我要去机场。我要飞往伦敦！

content.text: What did you put in your bag?
content.translation: 你在包里放了什么东西？

content.text: I put clothes, shoes, and my passport in my bag.
content.translation: 我在包里放了衣服、鞋子和我的护照。

content.text: When are you going to the airport?
content.translation: 你打算什么时候去机场？

content.text: At seven o'clock tomorrow morning.
content.translation: 明天早上七点。

content.text: Have a safe trip!
content.translation: 旅途安全！
